market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $85 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI $85 low requires ~-16.6% drop from $101.94 in 28 days. Although April briefly touched $82.59, current levels and ongoing geopolitical risk make a deep flush less likely without a full ceasefire and demand collapse. Tail risk plausible but not base case.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether ceasefire fully holds and demand weakness intensifies.
